cards.card_text: David reaches for a picture of ground being broken up and turned over in a field, and says, "…our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol."
cards.verse_text: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

cards.card_text: David compares those bones scattered at the mouth of Sheol to a picture from everyday life.
cards.verse_text: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

cards.card_text: Even with bones scattered at the mouth of Sheol, David says his eyes are fixed on ___.
cards.verse_text: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
